compiled_state.title: [test-two-layer-review-gate]: test_allowlist_pass_docs_only asserts docs-only skips Layer 1 -> fails after 3783 made docs reviewable
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
### Expected Behavior
Hook Tests job passes on the 3783 branch.

### Actual Behavior
tests/hooks/test-two-layer-review-gate.sh::test_allowlist_pass_docs_only FAILS (20 pass, 1 fail), blocking PR #651. The test (line 186-198) stages docs/README.md and asserts the pre-commit review gate (Layer 1) passes WITHOUT review (expected exit 0); now gets non-zero.

### Root (suspected)
Story 3783 (committed 4a1552b336 on this branch) intentionally tightened review-gate-allowlist.conf so documentation is REVIEWABLE — a docs-only commit must now require review, not skip Layer 1. This test still asserts the pre-3783 skip behavior. A DD4 re-baseline that was missed (the test was not in DD4's enumerated list).

### Evidence
CI Hook Tests log: '[199/215] test-two-layer-review-gate.sh ... FAIL (20 pass, 1 fail)'. Local repro: 'FAIL: test_allowlist_pass_docs_only expected: 0'.
